learning_extracted: The policy-control / explore-exploit-arbitration axis is refuted as the missing lever for the MECH-457 competence floor: a critic-utility mode gate produces zero consolidation gain over fixed-coefficient RND on both representations.

The residual gap is explorer CAPACITY to convert coverage->competence (RND plateaus at ~11% of the local-view ceiling), NOT exploration scheduling -- this sharpens the second half of the mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer build target (adequate policy capacity/training budget), complementing the success-independent-drive half established by 752-754.

755 differs in shape from 752-754 (its RND arms clear the floor; the treatment adds nothing) yet converges on the same structural conclusion -- convergence across two different failure shapes on the same claim is the load-bearing signal, not two independent nulls.

The four-axis single-mechanism portfolio (752/753/754/755) is now closed with a single floor-clear (751 RND); the additivity pair 756 remains in flight but the cold-start/capacity reading predicts it also fails.

cluster_pattern.shape: Across the GOV-FANOUT-1 single-axis portfolio, NO mechanism bolted onto exploration lifts competence above raw success-independent novelty: 752 (backward credit sweep), 753 (Go-Explore archive/return) and 754 (AMIGo goal-frontier) collapse to the sparse-RL baseline (~0.15-0.45, sub-floor); 755 (critic-utility explore/exploit gate) clears the floor via its RND arms but adds no gain over fixed-coef RND (+0.30/-0.37). Only 751 (unsupervised RND explorer) cleared the 1.0 floor (5.22), and even it reaches only ~11% of the 48 local-view ceiling.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: COLD-START + CAPACITY. Two joined halves: (1) success-dependence -- mechanisms that amplify signal derived from prior task success (credit/return/curriculum) cannot bootstrap from ~0 competence (752-754); only success-INDEPENDENT drives (RND 751, BC 748) break the floor. (2) capacity/conversion -- even a competent arbitration controller over a success-independent drive (755 mode gate) cannot squeeze more competence from a low-capacity explorer; the ceiling is the explorer's capacity to convert coverage into competence. The build target mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer must satisfy BOTH: compose ARC-065/MECH-314 curiosity as a success-independent bootstrap drive AND add adequate policy capacity/training budget for floor->competent.
